executive_summary: Trump-Iran two-week ceasefire announced late Tuesday. Iran confirmed acceptance contingent on complete Strait of Hormuz reopening. WTI crude collapsed from $117 to ~$94/barrel (-16%), the single largest one-day drop in years. Equity futures across all indices surged 2.5-3.5% with Russell 2000 leading at +3.62%, reflecting small-cap domestic relief from lower fuel costs. The dominant intraday trade is rotation: long airlines, trucking, cruise lines, retailers; short or avoid energy majors. Key risk: ceasefire expires in two weeks — any breakdown reverses the entire move.
